title: MaleTheme Duo #020 · 남 피트니스 모델·골드 글리터·닌자 테마 / 남 클래식 머슬·실버 포일·군인 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a wide pedestrian walkway on a large suspension bridge with a waist-high railing, standard lamp posts and the city skyline in daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Korean man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, luminous porcelain skin, a calm gentle gaze, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold ship's anchor, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough tin a cube-shaped block hanging at its end, and a single gold hair ornament. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, smooth warm bronze skin, a cool composed look, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a bronze small flared temple bell, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold bracelet. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge, two silver dog-tag chains hanging on his bare chest, and a minimal camouflage-pattern T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
